SELECT ('PJT' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12),GETDATE(),112),3,2) + dbo.FN_LPAD( CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), CONVERT(INTEGER,( CASE WHEN MAX(PJT_CD) IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE SUBSTRING(MAX(PJT_CD), 6,5) END ) )+1),5,'0') ) AS PJT_CD FROM T_PROJECT WHERE PJT_CD LIKE 'PJT%'
INSERT INTO T_PROJECT (COMPANY_CD ,PJT_CD ,PJT_NM ,SMP_CD ,SMP_CHASU ,CUST_CD ,EUSR_CD ,USER_CD ,DEPT_CD ,BIZ_TYPE ,DSTR_TYPE ,PJT_SDATE ,PJT_EDATE ,BASE_CRNY ,END_YN ,USE_YN ,REG_DT ,REG_USR )VALUES( #company_cd# ,#pjt_cd# ,#pjt_nm# ,#smp_cd# ,#smp_chasu# ,#cust_cd# ,#eusr_cd# ,#user_cd# ,#dept_cd# ,#biz_type# ,#dstr_type# ,replace(#pjt_sdate#,'-','') ,replace(#pjt_edate#,'-','') ,#base_crny# ,#end_yn# ,#use_yn# ,GETDATE() ,#reg_usr# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_PROJECT SET PJT_NM = #pjt_nm# ,CUST_CD = #cust_cd# ,EUSR_CD = #eusr_cd# ,USER_CD = #user_cd# ,DEPT_CD = #dept_cd# ,BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type# ,DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type# ,PJT_SDATE = replace(#pjt_sdate#,'-','') ,PJT_EDATE = replace(#pjt_edate#,'-','') ,BASE_CRNY = #base_crny# ,END_YN = #end_yn# ,USE_YN = #use_yn# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND PJT_CD = #pjt_cd#
statements.select:
SELECT P.PJT_CD, P.PJT_NM, P.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, P.EUSR_CD, C2.CUST_NM AS EUSR_NM, P.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, P.DSTR_TYPE, CD.CODE_NM AS DSTR_TYPE_NM FROM T_PROJECT P LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER C ON P.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND P.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER U ON P.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND P.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT D ON U.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER C2 ON P.COMPANY_CD = C2.COMPANY_CD AND P.EUSR_CD = C2.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CODE CD ON P.DSTR_TYPE = CD.CODE_ID WHERE P.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND P.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND P.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND U.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #user_nm# + '%'
AND P.PJT_NM LIKE '%' + #pjt_nm# + '%'
AND C.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%' AND P.CUST_CD IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY P.PJT_NM
